notes:
CRM style notes: 
- Company is mid-market SaaS that powers in-app help and proactive recommendations.
- Started with Hosted API to iterate quickly; shifted to Dedicated due to compliance and predictable latency needs.
- Preferred models: open quantized variants for embeddings, medium-size chat model for cost/latency balance.
- Security: require SSO/SAML, KMS integration, SIEM-forwarded audit logs, and data residency assurances (EU & NA).
- Legal concerns: they want higher liability cap and narrower indemnity; specifically worried about model hallucination risk and customer data exposure.
- Procurement: insists on PO + insurance certificate before provisioning Dedicated; also wants a vendor onboarding questionnaire completed.
- SE comments: recommend canary + model fallback policy to smaller model when capacity falls below threshold; propose token-level telemetry dashboard for their ops team.
- CTO quote: "We cannot accept platform behavior that causes data to cross regions, and we need contractual guarantees around retention/deletion."
- Internal: AE coordinating with Contracts SME (Ben K.) and Security eng to produce subprocessor + SOC2 pack. SE to validate runbook for production cutover.
- Risk: If Redwood cannot meet DPA deletion window and residency carve-outs, CopperEdge will seek alternative dedicated vendors or extend Hosted with restrictive network controls.
